SELECT a.srvc_qstn_id AS qstn_id, a.cmpy_id AS cmpy_id, a.srvc_qstn_clsf_cd AS inquiry_type_cd, (SELECT cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd WHERE cd_grop_cd = 'SRVC_QSTN_CLSF_CD' AND cmmn_cd = a.srvc_qstn_clsf_cd AND lcal_cd = 'ko') AS inquiry_type_nm, SUBSTRING(a.srvc_qstn_cn, 1, 100) AS inquiry_cn, a.srvc_qstn_cn AS qstn_cn, CASE WHEN a.atch_file_group_id IS NOT NULL AND a.atch_file_group_id != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_file, a.atch_file_group_id AS atch_file_group_id, c.cmpy_nm AS cmpy_nm, a.rgtr_id AS mbr_id, a.svc_qstn_nm AS inquirer_nm, a.rgtr_id AS inquirer_id, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS rcpt_dt, CASE WHEN a.srvc_ans_dt IS NOT NULL THEN '답변완료' ELSE '답변대기' END AS answer_yn, TO_CHAR(a.srvc_ans_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS answer_dt, a.srvc_ans_cn AS answer_cn, a.svc_ans_nm AS answerer_nm FROM cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn a LEFT JOIN cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_inf c ON a.cmpy_id = c.cmpy_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.reg_dt >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{fromDt} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND a.reg_dt <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{toDt} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND a.srvc_ans_dt IS NULL
AND a.srvc_ans_dt IS NOT NULL
AND a.srvc_qstn_clsf_cd = #{inquiryTypeCd}
AND c.cmpy_nm LIKE '%' || #{cmpyNm} || '%'
AND a.srvc_qstn_cn LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND a.srvc_qstn_id < #{lastQstnId}
ORDER BY a.reg_dt DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn SET srvc_ans_cn = #{answerCn}, srvc_ans_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, mdfr_id = #{mdfrId}, mdfcn_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, svc_ans_nm = #{answerNm} WHERE srvc_qstn_id = #{qstnId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn ( cmpy_id, srvc_qstn_id, srvc_qstn_clsf_cd, srvc_qstn_cn, srvc_qstn_rcpt_yn, view_use_yn, atch_file_group_id, svc_qstn_nm, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{srvcQstnId}, #{srvcQstnClsfCd}, #{srvcQstnCn}, 'Y', 'Y', #{atchFileGroupId}, #{svcQstnNm}, #{rgtrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{mdfrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.reg_dt DESC) AS rn, a.cmpy_id, a.srvc_qstn_id, a.srvc_qstn_clsf_cd, (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'SRVC_QSTN_CLSF_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = a.srvc_qstn_clsf_cd AND s.lcal_cd = 'ko') AS srvc_qstn_clsf_nm, a.srvc_qstn_cn, a.srvc_ans_cn, TO_CHAR(a.srvc_ans_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS srvc_ans_dt, a.srvc_bigo AS srvc_rmrk, a.srvc_qstn_rcpt_yn, a.rgtr_id, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, a.svc_qstn_nm, a.svc_ans_nm, CASE WHEN a.atch_file_group_id IS NOT NULL AND a.atch_file_group_id != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS file_yn, a.atch_file_group_id, CASE WHEN a.srvc_ans_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS answer_yn, (SELECT STRING_AGG(f.file_nm, ' / ' ORDER BY f.reg_dt) FROM cdm_own.cmpt_atch_file f WHERE f.atch_file_group_id = a.atch_file_group_id AND COALESCE(f.del_yn, 'N') != 'Y') AS file_names FROM cdm_own.cmpt_srvc_qstn a WHERE a.cmpy_id = #{companyId} AND a.rgtr_id = #{loginId}
AND a.srvc_ans_dt IS NOT NULL
AND a.srvc_ans_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY a.reg_dt DESC
